device_sync.connect_prompt.text: Connect a device to sync factual metrics you already track elsewhere.

device_sync.connected.text: Device connected. Synced readings will appear in your history.

device_sync.disconnected.text: Device disconnected. Past synced readings remain in your history.

device_sync.metric_synced.text: Reading synced from your connected device.

device_sync.provider_score_rejected.text: This reading could not be synced because it included a provider-computed score, which this product does not store.

device_sync.no_engine_change.text: Device sync data does not change engine truth, programme assignment, or replay/proof records.
